Inherent forecast uncertainty persists from potential convective timing, with new ECMWF outputs due May 2 evening potentially shifting odds before resolution.

The close split reflects ensemble uncertainty: drier scenarios with partial clearing could nudge peaks to 21°C, while thicker stratus decks suppress to 20°C. Watch INMET's daily bulletin and afternoon model refreshes for shifts ahead of resolution via official airport observations.
